resolution: Replaced every eval-string dispatch in the native system-signal producer with typed optional V8 global calls. A missing IFTTT handler after context reset now drops the event instead of throwing, covering RAM, VRAM, cursor, focus, resize, pointer-device, slow-frame, hang, and file-drop callbacks. Added four-float typed dispatch support and pinned representative memory byte payloads across the JS Number boundary. Zig system-memory tests and an isolated ReleaseFast editor build pass; the running dev host must be rebuilt/restarted for live confirmation.
